targets.title: Preliminary evidence for deficits in multisensory integration in autism spectrum disorders: The mirror neuron hypothesis
targets.evidence_quote: We performed a registered replication of the Oberman and Ramachandran (Soc Neurosci 3(3–4):348–355, 2008) study on the ‘kiki/bouba’ effect in autism spectrum conditions (ASC).
targets.outcome_quote: We report partial replication of the diminished ‘kiki/bouba’ effect in individuals with ASC compared to the neurotypical control group.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly call this a partial replication. They report that the direct five-pair replication failed, whereas analyses excluding problematic pairs supported the difference.
